subject: Pilot onboarding — invoice-only path for trial
messages:
From: Tom Jensen <tom.jensen@clearlakebio.com>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@clearlakebio.com>
Date: Sat, 18 Apr 2026 16:22:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot onboarding — PO requirement question

Hi Karthik,

Thanks again for the demo today — the team is excited to run a four-week pilot of Redwood for our internal R&D search workflows. Two quick procurement questions before we can start billing:

1) Our procurement group typically issues POs for any vendor payments, but procurement is backed up and won't be able to generate a PO before the pilot start date. Can we proceed on an "invoice-only" path for the pilot period and convert to a PO if/when procurement completes their workflow?

2) I've attached our W-9 and a proposed SOW (SOW_v1.pdf). Are there any vendor forms Redwood needs from us to speed vendor setup?

We can keep the pilot budget under $25,000 if that helps. If there's a short-term alternative (temporary exception or purchase-order waiver) please let me know the approvals you need and any constraints on liability/terms.

Thanks,
Tom Jensen
Head of Research IT
ClearLake Biotech
Attachments: Clearlake_W9.pdf, SOW_v1.pdf

From: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: monica_patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 18 Apr 2026 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Pilot onboarding — PO requirement question

Folks — forwarding ClearLake's note. They want to start a 4-week pilot but procurement can't issue a PO in time. W-9 and SOW attached.

Proposal: short-term invoice-only path for the pilot capped at $20K (or $25K if finance prefers), contingent on:
- Completed quick vendor intake (minimal fields) + W-9 on file
- Signed SOW or DocuSign acknowledgement of scope
- Standard Redwood T&Cs (no custom redlines for pilot)

Can procurement/finance confirm whether we can grant a one-time PO waiver for pilots under this cap and what signoffs we need (legal/finance/manager)? Marissa — does sales need to record anything in the deal? Laura/Monica — are there GL, payment-terms, or tax checks required to issue invoices?

Quoted from Tom's email below.

—Karthik

On Sat, Apr 18, 2026 at 4:22 PM Tom Jensen <tom.jensen@clearlakebio.com> wrote:
> Thanks again for the demo today — the team is excited to run a four-week pilot of Redwood for our internal R&D search workflows...

From: monica_patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 18 Apr 2026 18:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Pilot onboarding — PO requirement question

Karthik — thanks for the ping. We can support an "invoice-only" path for short pilots but need to follow a couple of controls so we don't create risk in vendor onboarding:

1) Vendor verification: W-9 on file is required (they attached it). I'll run a quick vendor name/TIN check.
2) Financial cap & duration: I recommend capping to $20,000 and max 30 days for the pilot. If you want $25k we'd need an exec approval from Laura.
3) SOW / terms: Require a signed SOW or DocuSign confirmation referencing our standard Master Services Agreement (MSA) or our enclosed pilot addendum. No custom legal redlines for pilots — if they push, we escalate to Legal.
4) Quick intake: please ask the customer to complete the attached vendor_onboard_quickform.pdf (minimal fields: remit address, tax id, contact, invoice email). I can provision a temporary vendor record upon receipt.

If Laura signs off on the $25k cap we can allow billing before the PO; otherwise we'll stick to $20k. I'll also need billing remittance and GL code for invoice routing. I'll open JIRA PROC-4291 to track.

—Monica

Attachments: vendor_onboard_quickform.pdf

From: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: monica_patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 19 Apr 2026 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Pilot onboarding — PO requirement question

Thanks team — to expedite, I'm comfortable approving an invoice-only path for this pilot with constraints:
- Maximum pilot spend: $25,000 total
- Duration limit: 30 days from first invoice date
- Payment terms: Net30 on our side; we will create a vendor record and set standard payment terms

Requirements before we accept invoices: completed quickform (to capture remit and tax info), W-9 on file (they provided), signed SOW or DocuSign link that references the Redwood MSA/pilot addendum. Monica — please open the vendor record and set GL code 7100-Research for initial billing.

Marissa — please log the special payment path on the HubSpot deal record (link below) and confirm the point of contact for invoice submission. Karthik — once they submit the quickform and sign the SOW I will communicate to AP that invoices from ClearLake for up to $25k are okay without an accompanying PO for this pilot only.

Laura Bennett
VP, Finance
Redwood Inference

Related: HubSpot deal CLB-4521

From: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tom Jensen <tom.jensen@clearlakebio.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@clearlakebio.com>

Date: Sun, 19 Apr 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot onboarding — invoice-only path for trial

Tom / Priya — quick update and next steps so we can get your pilot scheduled next week:

Agreed path (approved by Finance):
- Redwood will accept invoice-only billing for this 4-week pilot, capped at $25,000 total and limited to 30 days.
- Requirements before we will accept invoices: completed vendor_onboard_quickform.pdf, W-9 on file (received), signed SOW via DocuSign.

Action items for ClearLake:
- Complete & return vendor_onboard_quickform.pdf (remit address, TIN, invoice email).
- Sign SOW_v1 via DocuSign: https://na1.docusign.net/Member/PowerFormSigning.aspx?PowerFormId=abc123
- Send any sample invoices to invoices@redwoodinference.com and copy your Redwood contact (me).

Internal owners: Monica will open the vendor record and set GL 7100-Research; Laura has approved the cap and duration; Marissa will add the special payment path to HubSpot (CLB-4521). I've attached a sample_invoice.pdf showing required fields to help your AP team.

If you can return the quickform and sign the SOW by Wednesday we can turn the pilot on Thursday morning.

Thanks — looking forward to getting started.

—Karthik Iyer
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
Attachments: sample_invoice.pdf
